title: Florea and Kiriago claim Sierre-Zinal victories
claims: World Athletics reports that the 2026 Sierre-Zinal was held on Saturday 8 August over 31 km as a stage of the WMRA World Cup.
The same report states that the course climbs from 560 m in Sierre to a high point of 2,424 m over the opening 24 km, then descends 7 km to the finish in Zinal.

The same report gives the 2026 men's result as Philemon Kiriago 2:26:24, Patrick Kipngeno 2:26:56 and Michael Saoli 2:29:36, an all-Kenyan podium, with Jacob Adkin fourth in 2:30:49 and Kevin Kibett fifth in 2:30:58.
The same report gives the 2026 women's result as Madalina Florea 2:55:44, Caroline Kimutai 2:56:30 and Morven Goodrum 2:57:12, with Oria Liaci fourth in 2:58:36 and Nienke Brinkman fifth in 2:58:53.
The same report states that Kiriago's 2026 win was his third Sierre-Zinal victory, after 2023 and 2025.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取世界田联 2026-08-08 赛后报道全文。报道署名含 'With assistance from WMRA'。女子冠军成绩与 GTWS 报道相差 2 秒，本页并列保留。
